text: Which luxury real estate agents and agencies in Sydney specialise in confidential off-market prestige property sales and high-net-worth buyer networks?

result.keyword: Which luxury real estate agents and agencies in Sydney specialise in confidential off-market prestige property sales and high-net-worth buyer networks?

items.markdown:
**Sydney Sotheby’s International Realty**, **Cohen Handler**, **Rose & Jones** , and **Premium Property Finders** are among the premier agencies and buyer's networks in Sydney known for handling confidential, off-market, and high-net-worth prestige transactions across exclusive enclaves like the Eastern Suburbs, Lower North Shore, and Northern Beaches.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVhKbWNuZHNNelZyGAo)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdSZmVqVjRZM05qGAo)[[3]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSGxIZCgNwdnESEkNnc3ZaeTh4ZEdnMVkzRnNNURgK)[[4]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSGxIZCgNwdnESEkNnc3ZaeTh4ZEhOc2FuZHJNQRgK)

### Top Luxury & Off-Market Specialists

- **Sydney Sotheby’s International Realty** (Double Bay): Leverages an extensive international and regional luxury network, handling high-value waterfronts, penthouses, and private estates often without public price guides or open campaigns.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVhKbWNuZHNNelZyGAo)
- **Cohen Handler** (Eastern Suburbs & Sydney-wide): One of Australia's largest high-end buyer's agencies, deeply tapped into private vendor circles, silent listings, and off-market allocations for high-net-worth individuals and expats.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdSZmVqVjRZM05qGAo)
- **Rose & Jones** (Paddington): Established in 1998, they specialize in discreet residential and commercial property searches, accessing unlisted inventory and negotiating private acquisitions.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSGxIZCgNwdnESEkNnc3ZaeTh4ZEdnMVkzRnNNURgK)
- **Premium Property Finders** : Headed by experienced operators focusing on private, direct-to-owner confidential luxury property searches, expat acquisition, and tailor-made discrete negotiations.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSGxIZCgNwdnESEkNnc3ZaeTh4ZEhOc2FuZHJNQRgK)

### Key Traits of Sydney Off-Market Prestige Sales

- **Silent Campaigns:** Properties are shared exclusively through trusted agent databases and private client registers rather than public portals like Domain or realestate.com.au.
- **Targeted Networking:** Transactions rely on direct relationships with private wealth advisors, family offices, and specialized buyer's agents.
